priorityList: Cast Shadow Bolt if below 2 Soul Shards.
Focus on casting as many Hand of Gul'dan as possible.
Cast Implosion with 6 Wild Imps out and 1 or less Demonic Core.
Cast Summon Demonic Tyrant while Dreadstalkers are active to extend their duration.
Cast Vile Fiend on cooldown to apply and maintain Wither via the Soul Harvester specialization.
Use Implosion with 6 or more Wild Imps, or fewer if the targets are about to die.
Cast Hand of Gul'dan when you have 3 or more Soul Shards to generate Wild Imps.
Use Power Siphon if you have at least 2 Wild Imps and no Demonic Core stacks available.
Use Demonbolt with Demonic Core procs to generate Soul Shards.
Cast Shadow Bolt to generate Soul Shards as a filler.
